answer: Every identity posts a $10 refundable deposit; each epoch a public pulse draws 1 in 20 for audit. The pick has 90 seconds to show a signed activity log; five auditors check it against the registry. A failed audit burns the deposit and fines the funding bridge $100 times the square of clones already caught from it. A 100-clone ring expects 5 audits and loses $5,550, its stake at its nadir; 100 honest agents lose $0. 200 clones would face $38,500, seven times the bill for twice the ring. A clone farm here is a shoplifter stealing louder each time while the alarm only gets sharper.
